class.label: Read-only reentrancy: external protocol reads stale Balancer V2 pool state mid-exit

remediation.summary: When pricing assets against an external pool's reserves, use Balancer's read-only reentrancy guard (ensureNotInVaultContext) before reading getPoolTokens, or snapshot reserves outside the vulnerable exit/join callback window. Treat any cross-protocol pricing read as reentrancy-sensitive.
